references.text: The first census was conducted by Moses and Aaron in the wilderness of Sinai, while this second census was conducted by Moses and Eleazar on the plains of Moab.
The introduction to this census also mentions the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho as the place where the counting took place.
The plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho is the place where the Israelites camped and received further instructions from the Lord through Moses.
The Israelite camp in the plains of Moab by the Jordan, directly opposite Jericho, is the same geographical area.
Eleazar was appointed as priest after his father Aaron, and here he serves alongside Moses in the census.
The plains of Moab were the last place where Moses stayed before he died and was buried.
Eleazar, the priest who participated in the census, is also mentioned in connection with the division of the inheritance in the land of Canaan.
